title: Act: Confirm admin round routes are mounted from adminRoundRoutes in server.New
summary: Confirm New mounts adminRoundRoutes behind admin.Middleware and make no product change unless a route is missing
description: The code already registers the five round routes via adminRoutes(eh, rh) inside r.Route("/api/v1/admin"). Read it and keep it unchanged; add a missing route only if one of the five is absent.

Given New, when it builds the admin group, then admin.Middleware(cfg.Admin.Token) is applied before the routes
